description: Custom ECL queries for Creatinine (SNOMED component 15373003). Routine renal parameter; the pool is every observable with Component = Creatinine, any specimen (serum, plasma, blood, urine, body fluids).
_loinc_survey_doc: LOINC-side recall survey (Loinc.csv of the pinned LOINC release): regexes on COMPONENT / PROPERTY / SYSTEM that select the LOINC terms a laboratory physician would count as this analyte (CLASSTYPE 1, not DEPRECATED). The generator reports how many of them the LOINC Ontology pool reaches.

queries.name: Creatinine, any measurement property
queries.description: All creatinine observables with a measurement property.
